title: Answer: mammals with a thalamocortical system, not present language models

statements.text: What is conscious is known with confidence only for brains in bodies, and the theory concerns the mammalian thalamocortical system. Present language models, topologically very simple by comparison, are not ascribed phenomenal consciousness, though the mammalian brain is not claimed to be the only possible architecture.

sources.quote: we are hesitant to ascribe phenomenal consciousness to present-day LLMs, which are topologically extremely simple in comparison
Although we are not arguing that the mammalian brain is the only architecture capable of supporting conscious awareness
